caption: Hilma af Klint, Group IX/UW, No. 25, The Dove, No. 1 (1915)
alt: An abstract painting: a large pale circle with a pink heart shape at its centre, cut by a vertical band of twisting coloured spirals, over a ground divided into blue, yellow, grey and brown, with a fan of rainbow colours at the bottom.
